description: Audited NORMAL-pass object techniques reachable by the locked highest-quality retail profile. Every entry is cross-checked against pipeline_manifest.json and either decoded retail SCR effect source or a named binary/document witness.

excluded: the two untyped fixed-function fallbacks selected only when pixel shaders are disabled

source_corpus.encoding: NovaLogic SCR stream, decoded with the repository SCR algorithm and key 0xA55B1EED

channel_contract.rgb_gen: SelfLumColor/RgbGen modulates RGB only for _FFP SELFLUM techniques.
channel_contract.alpha_gen: MaterialDiffuse.a/AlphaGenValue modulates alpha only for _FFP TBoringFFP techniques; shader-based NORMAL effects consume their authored texture/vertex channels directly.
channel_contract.specular_alpha: Standard Phong reads raw Diffuse1.a as pow-8 brightness; PhongMap reads it as brightness and pow-4/pow-64 interpolation weight.
channel_contract.coverage: Every runtime technique names diffuse, normal-map, vertex-diffuse, reflect-color, or zero coverage explicitly in pipeline_manifest.json.

normal_pass_audit.point_light_execution: Reachable POINTLIGHT_VARIATIONS and ONCE_PER_POINTLIGHT passes are folded into the selected technique's bounded four-light sum while retaining each source stage's vertex/pixel split.
normal_pass_audit.spotlight_execution: ONCE_PER_SPOTLIGHT branches are source-audited but unreachable in the shipped JO runtime: LightPool_SpawnSpotProjectorEffect has no caller, and model LGHT falloff/rotation/view-projection never enter the pool.
normal_pass_audit.single_pass_limit: Godot combines reachable NORMAL passes into one material. Independent source-pass alpha tests are exact where they share primary coverage; exceptional post-pass coverage is bounded per technique under D-RMAT-6.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is modulated by saturated vertex diffuse at 2x. MaterialDiffuse.a (AlphaGenValue) multiplies Diffuse1.a only on this _FFP path; the resulting alpha supplies blend/cutout coverage.
techniques.light_response: Geometric vertex normal; hemisphere plus directional plus selected D3D-style point lights, saturated before MODULATE2X.
techniques.state: NORMAL pass; static policy table selects opaque/alpha/additive, cutout compare, culling, depth write, and regular/additive fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1 supplies RGB and coverage directly. Unlike _FFP, SkBasic never consumes MaterialDiffuse/AlphaGenValue and has no SELFLUM specialization.
techniques.light_response: Skinned geometric vertex normal; hemisphere plus directional plus selected D3D-style point lights.
techniques.state: SkBasic NORMAL pass; opaque with optional alpha-test cutout, back-face culling, depth write, and regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse2.rgb multiplies the lit Diffuse1 result at 2x and Diffuse2.a multiplies alpha. MaterialDiffuse.a (AlphaGenValue) also multiplies alpha on this _FFP path; a missing secondary texture drops the detail stage.
techniques.light_response: Same geometric vertex-light response as Fixed; the detail stage changes material channels, not lighting.
techniques.state: NORMAL pass with the same six static policies as Fixed.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is multiplied by SelfLumColor (RgbGen) and saturated ColorSrcGlobalGain at 2x. Retail SELFLUM writes alpha zero; AlphaGenValue is not consumed.
techniques.light_response: Unlit by world or point lights; responds only to ColorSrcGlobalGain as retail SELFLUM does.
techniques.state: NORMAL SELFLUM specialization with the six static material policies.

techniques.channels: Self-lit Diffuse1 is multiplied by SelfLumColor (RgbGen), global source gain, and Diffuse2.rgb at 2x stages. Retail SELFLUM still writes alpha zero; AlphaGenValue is not consumed.
techniques.light_response: Unlit by world or point lights; responds only to the global source gain.
techniques.state: NORMAL SELFLUM specialization with the six static material policies.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb times squared absolute eye/normal facing; alpha is coverage only for optional cutout.
techniques.light_response: Unlit and unaffected by directional, hemisphere, or point-light changes.
techniques.state: Additive ONE/ONE, no depth write, additive fog attenuation; optional alpha cutout does not enable depth writes.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is MODULATE2X with the animated vertex diffuse; Diffuse1.a supplies optional cutout coverage.
techniques.light_response: Animated/camera-oriented reconstructed normal responds to hemisphere and directional light only; Flag.fx has no point-light pass and no SELFLUM technique.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass with regular shader fog and optional cutout coverage.
techniques.raster_check_note: Flag.fx reconstructs norm.x as ca*0.5+0.5 (never negative) and norm.y as -sa*0.1; response deltas are required, but a generic left/right or sky/ground spatial-lobe sign flip is not.

techniques.channels: Tangent-space normal map drives per-pixel N.L; Diffuse1.rgb is the albedo and alpha is optional cutout coverage.
techniques.light_response: Hemisphere plus mapped-normal directional and point diffuse, with the retail geometric-normal self-shadow multiplier on each lit pass.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is albedo; Diffuse1.a is both coverage and pow-8 specular brightness on this unskinned tag.
techniques.light_response: Mapped-normal Phong diffuse/specular for directional and point lights; all passes use geometric-normal self-shadow.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular base fog plus additive point-pass fog semantics.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is albedo; Diffuse1.a is coverage and pow-8 specular brightness.
techniques.light_response: Skinned tangent-space mapped-normal Phong; pow-8 directional/point specular and retail point-pass self-shadow, with no directional self-shadow in the shipped skinned vertex program.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular base fog plus additive point-pass fog semantics.

techniques.channels: Object-space normal map drives per-pixel N.L; Diffuse1.rgb is albedo and alpha is optional cutout coverage.
techniques.light_response: Hemisphere plus mapped-normal directional and point diffuse with geometric-normal self-shadow.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is albedo; Diffuse1.a controls both optional coverage and pow-8 specular brightness.
techniques.light_response: Object-space mapped-normal pow-8 Phong for directional/point lights; point passes self-shadow, while the standard directional pass does not.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular base fog plus additive point-pass fog semantics.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1.rgb is albedo; raw Diffuse1.a is PhongMap gloss/brightness data alpha*mix(sampled pow4,sampled pow64,alpha). The lookup's sampled alpha supplies N.L. NORMAL cutout coverage comes from the vertex diffuse alpha/self-shadow channel, not Diffuse1.a; AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Flat AmbientColor plus skinned object-space mapped-normal PhongMap for directional/point lights, including the geometric self-shadow multiplier; it does not consume the oriented hemisphere gradient.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass; optional object cutout tests vertex diffuse alpha while the combined shader output alpha remains fixed because Diffuse1.a is gloss data.

techniques.channels: The tangent normal texture drives lighting and its alpha is NORMAL coverage. Diffuse1 supplies albedo only; a missing Diffuse2 drops the optional detail stage. AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Mapped-normal hemisphere and directional diffuse with directional geometric self-shadow. The fixed-function encoded-vector point pass uses mapped N.L and interpolated attenuation without geometric self-shadow.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Mapped Diffuse1 is post-multiplied by Diffuse2.rgb at 2x. Normal-map alpha is primary coverage and Diffuse2.a multiplies it; AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Same tangent-space mapped-normal diffuse response as Dot3Tangent.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1 supplies albedo and coverage. The tangent normal map supplies the encoded DOT3 vector; AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Skinned fixed-function DOT3: geometric-normal Gouraud hemisphere plus mapped directional/point N.L with attenuation and no CalcSelfShadowTerm multiplier.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1 supplies albedo and primary coverage, then Diffuse2 post-multiplies RGB at 2x and alpha at 1x. AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Same skinned fixed-function DOT3 light topology as Dot3TangentSkinned.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1 supplies albedo and coverage; the object-space normal map supplies the encoded DOT3 vector. A missing Diffuse2 drops the optional detail stage; AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Skinned fixed-function DOT3: geometric-normal Gouraud hemisphere plus mapped directional/point N.L with attenuation and no CalcSelfShadowTerm multiplier.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Diffuse1 supplies primary coverage; object-space mapped RGB is post-multiplied by Diffuse2.rgb at 2x and Diffuse2.a multiplies coverage. AlphaGenValue is ignored.
techniques.light_response: Same object-space mapped-normal diffuse response as Dot3Object.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass, optional cutout, regular fog.

techniques.channels: Tangent normal reflects the view into TexCubeEnvironment, tinted by ReflectColor. NORMAL base coverage is ReflectColor.a times the sampled cube alpha (the hosted system cube is opaque); Diffuse1 and AlphaGenValue do not contribute.
techniques.light_response: No diffuse lighting; each point light adds a pow-16 mapped-normal specular lobe with geometric self-shadow.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass with optional cutout and regular fog.

techniques.channels: P0 writes the mapped reflection with gray shader fog; P1 adds point-light pow-16 specular with black additive fog. Independent P3 samples Tex0, applies its own Diffuse1.a coverage test, and performs the retail DESTCOLOR/SRCCOLOR 2x postmultiply (over the linear scene copy since the ADR 0043 linear-scene amendment).
techniques.light_response: No diffuse lighting; point lights add pow-16 specular before the independent Diffuse1 postmultiply.
techniques.state: P0 is opaque with optional reflect-alpha cutout; P1 is additive ONE/ONE; P3 is an independent depth-tested/no-write geometry pass with optional diffuse-alpha cutout and regular fog.

techniques.channels: Ordinary Diffuse1.rgb/pow-8-alpha Phong plus TexCubeEnvironment tinted by ReflectColor; Diffuse1.a also supplies optional cutout coverage.
techniques.light_response: Mapped-normal directional/point Phong plus the independent reflection term; unskinned directional self-shadow is retained.
techniques.state: Opaque NORMAL pass with optional cutout and regular base/additive pass fog semantics.

techniques.channels: Reflected environment is tinted by ReflectColor and ColorSrcGlobalGain under MODULATE2X; Diffuse1 is not sampled in RGB and retail MaterialDiffuse.a is zero, so NORMAL/GLOW coverage is zero.
techniques.light_response: No direct diffuse/specular light response; appearance changes with the hosted environment cube and global source gain.
techniques.state: Additive ONE/ONE, no depth write, additive fog; optional alpha cutout remains no-write.

techniques.channels: Skinned reflected environment is tinted by ReflectColor under MODULATE2X; it intentionally omits Diffuse1 and ColorSrcGlobalGain. Coverage is ReflectColor.a times sampled cube alpha.
techniques.light_response: No direct diffuse/specular light response; appearance changes only with the hosted environment cube.
techniques.state: Additive ONE/ONE, no depth write, additive shader fog; optional alpha cutout remains no-write.
